messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT 1779999999 - cont-batcher throughput anomaly detected, kvstore eviction rate abnormal
Priya: paging, oncall here
Carlos: looking at dashboards. 17:46 UTC we see sudden flushes and lots of small batches
Lin: telemetry: p95 latency up, error spikes 502/503 from router
Evan: customer Streamly reports caption delays and 5xx errors at 17:47
Priya: what's recent rollout? any config changes?
Carlos: rollout id rollout/2026-03-14/contbatch-tune-12 deployed 17:10 UTC — it tightened timeout_ms from 15000 -> 8000 and increased max_num_seqs=48
Lin: I think shorter timeout + moderate num_seqs causes more frequent flushes of partial batches -> more KV churn
Support-Rep-Jess: Streamly contact: "we saw intermittent 502s and timeouts in live captions"
Priya: show me cont-batcher logs
Carlos: logs snippet:
```
W 17:47:02 cont-batcher: flush triggered: timeout_elapsed window_tokens=24000
I 17:47:02 cont-batcher: created 14 small batches due to timeout
W 17:47:03 kvstore: fragmentation_increase=high active_evictions=1200
E 17:47:04 router: backend=cont-batcher downstream=502 spike
```
Evan: also found that per-request kv_size_limit was accidentally removed in rollout config (bug), so even small batches can cause large kv allocations
Priya: mitigation plan: 1) revert timeout change 2) re-enable kv_size_limit 3) throttle non-critical routes
Carlos: applying temporary route QoS: reduce weight for streaming/bulk customers
Priya: executing rollback: `redwoodctl rollout revert rollout/2026-03-14/contbatch-tune-12` — doing controlled rollback to previous config
oncall-bot: rollback initiated by Priya
Carlos: re-enabled kv_size_limit via runtime patch: `redwoodctl config patch cont-batcher --kv_size_limit=4MB` — patch applied
Priya: restarted a subset of cont-batcher instances to pick up KV limit, doing 4 at a time
incident-bot: rollback complete, new revision active
Lin: monitoring: eviction rate halved within 6 minutes, 5xxs dropped to baseline
Evan: Streamly confirms reduced errors and restored stream freshness
Priya: add immediate follow-ups: block rollouts that decrease timeout_ms below 10s without preflight; add schema validation to ensure kv_size_limit present; add test simulating high-fanout many-short-batches
Carlos: filed ticket INFRA-7021 for rollout guardrails and INFRA-7022 for kv circuit breaker
Support-Rep-Jess: notified Streamly and closed their escalation ticket
Priya: assign owners: Carlos -> rollout preflight, Lin -> automation tests, Evan -> customer comms doc
Priya: will write incident summary and coord postmortem. tagging sev=2, impacted_customers=["Streamly"], regression=contbatch-timeout-tune
oncall-bot: handoff scheduled Priya -> Alex at 20:00 UTC
Priya: leaving notes and artifact pointers /artifacts/incidents/1779999999/
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-03-14-1779999999 created
Priya: marking incident resolved after 40m of stable metrics. will publish postmortem in 72h :white_check_mark:
Carlos: saving logs and heap profiles to /artifacts/incidents/1779999999/
